decisions.reason: The aloe vera line is still young, has its own page, and sits close to the core offer with low holding costs in small-batch production, so its option value remains worth preserving while demand evidence accumulates.

A hyaluronic serum fits the natural facial care range and shares production capabilities, and two years of presence without negative signals do not show that its value is unlikely to be realized, so keeping it costs little.
The cleansing milk is a staple that complements the line using shared raw materials, so the low cost of keeping it justifies holding the option while its prospects become clearer.

Launched only in 2024, the cleansing oil's value is still highly uncertain and it is cheap to keep alongside the cleansing milk, so abandoning it now would forfeit option value before any evidence arrives.
